newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT - Nikko downgrades Amoy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Nikko downgrades Amoy.

text.p: Nikko Research Center (H.K.) Ltd said it had lowered its rating on Amoy Properties Ltd to hold from buy and lowered its earnings forecast for fiscal year 1997 to HK$1.75 billion from HK$1.88 billion.

It said disappointing earnings growth of two percent at the company during 1995/96 is expected to weigh on the stock in the short term. Amoy Properties posted net profit of HK$1.58 billion for the year ended June 30 compared to HK$1.55 billion.
Nikko said rental income over the period was HK$45 million lower than its forecast due to a lack of new completions and few rental reversions in Amoy's investment property portfolio.
It said it had revised down its earnings forecast for 1996/97 after lowering its projections for rental income and profits from assets sales.
Nikko expects fiscal 1997 rental income to rise six percent to HK$2.29 billion and profits derived from asset disposals to rise to HK$25 million from HK$21 million in 1995/96.
Amoy Properties shares were steady at HK$8.95 in early Tuesday trade after falling HK$0.15 on Monday. The downgrade was issued at HK$9.10.
